about: Live 2026 report: KoolKisaan Flowers (ice panels, best practice) on real Visakhapatnam weather from 1 January 2026 to the newest saved hour.

date_range.label: 1 Jan 2026 – 17 Nov 2026 (321 days, real Visakhapatnam weather, digital twin)

weather_source: Open-Meteo archive (ERA5) + recent hours, saved in data/live/ (CC BY 4.0)
note: Digital twin (S). Nothing is measured. Best practice = realistic losses (hot-site weather correction included) + good design + good operation. Prices are E.

forecast.about: PREDICTION: the Open-Meteo forecast run through the twin, starting from today's simulated room and ice state. Not a result.

days.text: Storm or very dull day likely: do not take new flowers in, keep the door shut, expect grid backup. Check the IMD warning.

rules.note: E – same rules as the earlier KoolKisaan advisor: storm = thunderstorm / heavy-rain weather code, gusts above 60 km/h, sun below 1 kWh/m2 or rain of 64.5 mm or more (IMD 'heavy'); low sun = below 2.5 kWh/m2. We do not predict cyclones: check the official IMD warnings.
